Name: Adlai, Father of Shaphat
Summary: Father of Shaphat, over the herds in the valleys.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:29: Father of Shaphat, over the herds in the valleys.
LifeLesson: The mention of Adlai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
